item.tib: kun mkhyen bla ma mnyam med chen po rjes su dran pa'i ngag gi phreng ba bung ba rnam par rtsen pa'i dbyangs snyan
item.coloph: de ltar khams gsum pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu/ bod gangs can pa rnams kyi 'dren pa gcig pur gyur dang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med pa chen po zhes bdag nyid chen po gang gi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul rnams cung zad mthong king thos pa'i skal ba can du gyur pa na/ e ma snyigs ma'i dus 'dir yang 'di lta bu'i 'dren pa mchog tu gyur pa byung ba ni sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang 'dra ba gyur to snyam du 'dun pa dang / mos pa dang / dad pa thun mong ma yin pas yid cir yang g.yos pa na/ gang gi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i yon tan gyi rin po che'i tshogs du ma gcal du bkram pa las/ rang nyid kyi blo ngor ji ltar 'char ba'i mos snang dang sbyar te/ don la gnas pa'i yon tan gyi cha shas tsam gces par btus te/ snyan tshig gi sred bur spel legs su sbrel nas blo gsal dgyes pa'i rgyan phreng du krun (bskran) pa po ni/ rje sman ri ba'i bstan pa la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i skal ba can/ dbra rigs khod spungs kyi rgyud du skyes shing snyigs dus kyi lung rigs smra ba'i gshen btsun ngag dbang skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes 'bod pa de+is sug las su sbyar ba ste/ skye ba thams cad du rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa dang mi 'bral bar tshul bzhin spyod cing spel ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
